item.ropes.rope_coil.tooltip.fling: Right-click to fling the rope out; right-click again to pay out more
item.ropes.rope_coil.tooltip.wind: Sneak + right-click to wind the rope back in (or pick a loose rope up)
item.ropes.rope_coil.tooltip.release: Sneak + left-click to let the rope go
item.ropes.rope_coil.tooltip.grab: Empty hand + sneak + right-click near the far end to grab on
item.ropes.hook.tooltip.attach: Right-click near a rope's far end to fit the hook onto it
item.ropes.hook.tooltip.latch: A fitted hook latches onto ships it touches; grab the end to pull it off
